triage.kind_span: The Fund is issuing transferable rights (“Rights”) to its common shareholders of record as of the close of business on May 20, 2021 (the “Record Date”)

subject_names.span: Aberdeen Income Credit Strategies Fund (the “Fund”) is a diversified, closed-end management investment company.

subject_tickers.span: listed on the New York Stock Exchange (the “NYSE”) under the symbol “ACP”

security_class.span: for an aggregate of 5,812,247 common shares of beneficial interest, par value $0.001 per common share (the “Common Shares”)

rights_per_share.span: will receive one Right for each outstanding Common Share owned on the Record Date.

rights_per_new_share.span: The Rights entitle the holders to purchase one new Common Share for every three Rights held (1 for 3).

price_reference.span: will be determined based upon a formula equal to 92.5% of the average of the last reported sales price of a Common Share on the NYSE on the Expiration Date

price_pct.span: will be determined based upon a formula equal to 92.5% of the average of the last reported sales price of a Common Share on the NYSE on the Expiration Date

price_floor_pct_nav.span: If, however, the Formula Price is less than 87% of the Fund’s net asset value (“NAV”) per Common Share at the close of trading on the NYSE on the Expiration Date, the Subscription Price will be 87% of the Fund’s NAV per Common Share

record_date.span: to its common shareholders of record as of the close of business on May 20, 2021 (the “Record Date”)

expiration_date.span: The Offer will expire at 5:00 p.m., New York City time, on June 16, 2021, unless extended as described in this Prospectus Supplement (the “Expiration Date”).

transferable.span: The Rights are transferable and will be admitted for trading on the NYSE under the symbol “ACP.RT” during the course of the Offer.

over_subscription.span: Record Date Shareholders who fully exercise their Rights will be entitled to subscribe, subject to certain limitations and subject to allotment, for additional Common Shares covered by any unexercised Rights.

max_new_shares.span: entitling the holders of these Rights to subscribe (the “Offer”) for an aggregate of 5,812,247 common shares of beneficial interest

notes: Prospectus supplement (to prospectus dated April 27, 2021). Subscription price = 92.5% of the average of the last reported sales prices on the NYSE on the Expiration Date and the four preceding trading days (the Formula Price), floored at 87% of NAV per Common Share at the close on the Expiration Date; estimated subscription price $11.11. A Record Date Shareholder owning fewer than three Common Shares may subscribe for one full Common Share. No secondary over-allotment (increase in shares offered) found in the text. Rights trade as 'ACP.RT'. Only one expiration date stated.
